Use `Text.from_markup(value).plain` to search the visible text without Rich style tags, for example `Text.from_markup(item.text).plain`. `Text.from_markup` parses console markup into a `Text`; its `plain` property contains the rendered text. See the [Markup API](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst). For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
